description: Shared fuzzy filtering utilities for select list components, including functions for word boundary detection, fuzzy matching, filtering, and search text preparation.

methods.name: isWordBoundary
methods.description: Checks if a given position in text is at a word boundary based on boundary characters.

methods.name: findWordBoundaryIndex
methods.description: Finds the index where a query matches at a word boundary within a text.

methods.name: fuzzyMatchLower
methods.description: Performs a fuzzy match between pre-lowercased query and text, returning a score or null.

methods.name: fuzzyFilterLower
methods.description: Filters a list of items based on a space-separated query, using fuzzy matching.

methods.name: prepareSearchItems
methods.description: Prepares items for fuzzy filtering by concatenating and lowercasing label, description, and searchText fields.
